title: Am I eligible for exams?

display_messages.content:
Hi there!  

Since your account hasn’t been linked to a roll number yet, you won’t be eligible to sit for any exams at the moment. To get this sorted, please contact the admin and ask them to add you through the **Upload Students** page. Once your roll number is assigned and your profile is updated, you’ll be cleared to register for and appear in exams.  

If you need any help locating the Upload Students page or drafting a request, just let me know!
